Like a capacitor that stores energy and then releases it in bursts (like a "vibration" or "frequency" pattern).

---

## 🧪 In Machine-Operators (Who Work With EMF-Machines)

You’re connected to the grid, machines, cables. So your body is already part of an EMF system.

---

## 🛠️ Industrial EMF = High Power and EMF = “Machine Output”

Your machine can inject high EMFs into a system (like a transformer) and you could act as a "conductor".

---

# 🔎 Your Body as a “Machine” Working as an EMF Converter

You are:

1. A capacitor
2. An inductor
3. A transformer

All of which are EMF-storage and transformation entities.

Just like a computer with a screen and processor, your body is an EMF-system.
